reason: I want the field goal and the hook at home. Jalen Buckley has topped 100 rushing yards in back-to-back games, and Miami is expected to start true freshman Drew Bellisari again after injuries at quarterback.
countercase: Miami's run defense has allowed only 79.4 rushing yards per MAC game. Bellisari ran for 47 yards in his first start, and Miami ran for 301 as a team. They can shorten the game and keep it tight.

reason: I like Houston at home with multiple ways to score inside. The Rockets put up 54 paint points against the Clippers, and Phoenix is without center Mark Williams.
countercase: Phoenix beat Houston 102–99 earlier this month and hit 15 threes in its last game. That perimeter scoring can keep the Suns in it.

reason: I like getting more than a touchdown with Detroit at Ford Field. The Lions have won six straight, and Sam LaPorta has no game designation. Detroit can keep this within nine even if Chicago wins.
countercase: Chicago has won five straight without trailing. Its defense held opponents to 19.7 points per game entering this matchup. Pressure from Jeffrey Simmons can stall Detroit drives and let Chicago build a lead.

reason: I passed on Detroit +9.5 after rechecking the price. At −400 it needs an 80% cover rate, and Chicago’s pressure gives it a real path to a double-digit win. The $24.72 paper balance carries forward.

countercase: Iowa can take whole possessions away. Its 19-play drive against Illinois used 10:05, and Nebraska could spread the remaining targets around. Kickoff forecast was 39°F with a 10 mph wind.

review.countercase: Backup quarterback, wind and bracket coverage can limit intermediate throws. A four-catch game left Smith below 70 at Indiana.

review.workload: Last three team games: six catches for 77, five for 41 and seven for 109. Five catches for 41 with a long of 13 shows a path on short gains.
review.availability: Current Notre Dame two-deep lists Faison first at receiver and punt returner, and includes Greathouse on the injury list.
review.matchup: Syracuse gave up 100 receiving yards to Clemson’s Wesco and 69 to NC State’s Dozier. This game is indoors.
review.countercase: He had three catches for only 16 against Stanford. An early Notre Dame lead could reduce second-half targets.

reason: Smith reached 83 on ten catches at USC. Faison got to 41 on five catches with a long of 13 two games ago. Both have a way there on ordinary targets. The toughest part is Notre Dame throwing enough if it leads early.
